title: Juicy Filipino Chicken Bowl
description: A paleo-friendly Filipino dish featuring chicken cooked in a creamy sauce, served in a hot dolsot stone bowl.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the minced garlic and chopped onion to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Pour in the single cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir in the fish sauce, salt, and black pepper.
Reduce the heat to low and let the chicken simmer in the creamy sauce for 10 minutes.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the chicken and sauce in a hot dolsot stone bowl.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
